mechanism_narrative: Sustained low FEDFUNDS (below 0.2%) signals accommodative monetary policy, reducing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.2% (p-value > 0.05 vs. zero returns).

mechanism_narrative: UNRATE exceeding 8.5% indicates severe economic distress and reduced consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >40% of instances when UNRATE > 8.5% (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous GDPC1 growth and HOUST increase above 3-month averages signal robust consumer demand, driving positive equity returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint GDPC1/HOUST signal fails to predict positive returns when either series < 3-month average (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO below 95 reflects manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: INDPRO decline does not yield negative SPX returns in >50% of cases during manufacturing contraction (p-value > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth above 3-month average indicates rising consumer spending, increasing corporate revenue and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth does not correlate with positive SPX 20d returns (Rank IC < 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 220 signals inflationary pressure, triggering potential monetary tightening that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in >40% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220 (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent PAYEMS growth above 130,000 and UNRATE decline below 9.0% indicate labor market tightening, boosting consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: Joint PAYEMS/UNRATE signal fails to predict positive returns when either series < 6-month average (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: FEDFUNDS rising above 0.5% during monetary tightening cycles increases discount rates, reducing equity valuations and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in >50% of instances during monetary tightening cycles (p-value > 0.05 for positive returns).
